class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'customer'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String, nullable=False)
    balance = Column(DECIMAL, nullable=False, default=0)
    credit_limit = Column(DECIMAL, nullable=False, default=0)
models.description: Customer table with balance and credit limit.
models.name: Customer

models.code:
class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'order'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    customer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('customer.id'), nullable=False)
    amount_total = Column(DECIMAL, nullable=False, default=0)
    date_shipped = Column(DateTime)
    notes = Column(String)

    # customer = relationship('Customer', back_populates='orders')
models.description: Order table with foreign key to Customer and amount_total, date_shipped fields.
models.name: Order

models.code:
class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'item'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('order.id'), nullable=False)
    product_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('product.id'), nullable=False)
    quantity = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    unit_price = Column(DECIMAL, nullable=False)
    amount = Column(DECIMAL, nullable=False, default=0)

    # order = relationship('Order', back_populates='items')
    # product = relationship('Product')
models.description: Item table linking Orders and Products with quantity, unit price, and amount.
models.name: Item

rules.name: CheckCredit_Constraint1
rules.description: The Customer's balance is less than the credit limit.
rules.code:
Rule.constraint(validate=Customer,
                as_condition=lambda row: row.balance <= row.credit_limit,
                error_msg="Customer balance ({row.balance}) exceeds credit limit ({row.credit_limit})")

rules.name: CheckCredit_Sum1
rules.description: The Customer's balance is the sum of the Order amount_total where date_shipped is null.
rules.code:
Rule.sum(derive=Customer.balance, 
         as_sum_of=Order.amount_total, 
         where=lambda row: row.date_shipped is None)

rules.name: CheckCredit_Sum2
rules.description: The Order's amount_total is the sum of the Item amount.

rules.name: CheckCredit_Formula
rules.description: The Item amount is the quantity * unit_price.

rules.name: CheckCredit_Copy
rules.description: The Item unit_price is copied from the Product unit_price.

rules.name: AppIntegration_AfterFlush
rules.description: Send the Order to Kafka topic 'order_shipping' if the date_shipped is not None.
rules.code:
Rule.after_flush_row_event(on_class=Order, 
   calling=kafka_producer.send_row_to_kafka,
   if_condition=lambda row: row.date_shipped is not None,
   with_args={"topic": "order_shipping"})
